question: Players of an online game named pop songs from short clips as fast as they could. How quickly was the catchiest one named?
answer: In 2.3 seconds, for Wannabe: before the 5-second intro of a typical 2015 hit would have ended. Third place, Eye of the Tiger, took 2.6. Over 12,000 people played Hooked on Music in 2014; the title rests on a third of a second, among those who chose to play and the songs listed.
move: Before accepting a title like best ever, ask who was asked and from what list.
ask: Which best-ever title do I believe without asking who was asked?
